summary: Control API skeleton: models, REST and SSE per contract
epic_summary: WS-C Control API (FastAPI, sessions, runs, SSE events, approvals)
description:
Contracts: docs/02-architecture.md "Contracts" (REST, event stream, run record). Python 3.12, uv, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, Postgres from `deploy/compose.yaml` (port 5433).

## Do

* `backend/` uv project; package `anvil.api`. Tables: users, sessions, runs, events (run_id, seq, ts, type, agent, data jsonb), approvals.
* Endpoints: `POST /api/sessions`, `GET /api/sessions`, `POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages`, `GET /api/runs/{id}`, `GET /api/runs/{id}/events` (SSE, resume from `Last-Event-ID` = seq), `POST /api/approvals/{id}`.
* A `RunExecutor` interface with one method `start(run, message) -> async iterator of events`; the runtime story (Claude) plugs in. Until then, no fake executor in `main`; tests use a test double only under `tests/`.
* Bearer token auth with one demo user from `.env`.

## Acceptance

* `uv run python -m pytest` green; OpenAPI at `/docs`; SSE resume test.
